overview: The Fountain Valley City Council approved three major items during the October 20, 2026 meeting: the Consent Calendar passed 5-0, the Development Agreement for phases 1 and 2 at Magnolia Street and Recreation Circle was approved, and five new police positions plus budget amendments were authorized. The council also approved the city's Three-Year Goals for 2026-2028.
actions: Approved Consent Calendar items 5-0, including receipt and filing of October 6, 2026 meeting minutes and Register of Demands for $3,753,459.96
Approved Development Agreement Phase 1 and Phase 2 with Density Bonus and Affordable Housing Agreement for properties at 16800 Magnolia Street and 9025-9063 Recreation Circle
Approved addition of five police department positions, one risk management position, and reclassification of one fire department position with related FY 2026/27 budget amendments
Approved Three-Year Goals (2026-2028) and Six-Month Strategic Objectives (October – March 2027)
Closed session items on HCD Group Home regulations litigation and Boys and Girls Club real property negotiations at Los Alamos Street properties were held but no public outcome recorded
